Hello everyone, this is Duzhi Wu, and you can call me David.
I am from China, while I have my undergraduation study in Canada. 
I was studying in McMaster University, major in Computer Science and minor in Statistics. 
The reason why I choose data science as the program of my graduation study is because I am not interested in just coding. 
I love to analyze a group of data and to make a prediction of something might happen, with known of the probability calculation. 
Though data cannot totally make a decision for me, it at least can approximately show me a way.
